title: Add minimal full-stack setup (Express + SQLite backend, static client, Docker)
head: fullstack/setup
body:
Adds a minimal full-stack implementation for the Amperly API Dashboard (token vending + light confirmation).

What’s included:
- server/: Express API (vend-token, confirm-light, tokens debug), SQLite setup, Dockerfile, package.json
- client/: static UI (index.html, app.js, styles.css)
- docker-compose.yml, README.md, .gitignore

How to test:
1. Checkout branch fullstack/setup and run server: cd server && npm install && node index.js (or docker-compose up --build)
2. Open http://localhost:3000 and exercise Vend Token / Confirm Light forms

Notes & caveats: prototype only — no auth, rate limiting, or production hardening; tokens are returned once and stored hashed.
